CASE — #FreeSeptia

Video campaign for revision of the ITE Law

Context: Indonesia's ITE Law (Electronic Information and Transactions Law) has repeatedly been used to prosecute ordinary citizens, including workers and activists, over online speech, a pattern often compared to anti-SLAPP concerns elsewhere.

Collaborative advocacy with local NGOs demanding the release of Septia, prosecuted under the ITE Law for alleged defamation after speaking about her rights as a worker. Digital campaigning highlighted the law's misuse against labour activism.

#FreeSeptia · #TolakPembungkaman
View on Instagram
CASE — Mr. Wahyu

Online social campaign with SAFEnet

Context: street vendors and informal workers in Indonesia often have limited legal literacy, making them especially vulnerable to prosecution under vague online speech laws.

Designed and managed a social campaign for Wahyu, a street vendor criminalised after voicing concerns on TikTok. Used a human-centred storytelling approach, framing him as an ordinary person the law failed — building public pressure for his release.
